name: lumora-sleep
description: MCP server source for Lumora Sleep, a sleep mask in development. Exposes tools to get the product status and to join the waitlist for launch updates. Not published to npm; build it from the repository.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Return the single Lumora product, in development, with each capability labeled Built, Next test, Planned, or Design, and planned launch pricing.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get the Lumora product by id (lumora).

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Join the Lumora Sleep waitlist for launch updates by submitting an email address.

build: git clone https://github.com/TheVirus-Limiter/aurum && cd aurum/mcp && npm install && npm run build
